title: HumilityAFM - Wooden Mosaic Alternate Recipes
description: An addon datapack for the Humility AFM mod adding alternate wooden mosaic recipes that do not collide with the crafting table.
body:
## An addon datapack for the [Humility AFM](https://modrinth.com/mod/humility-afm) mod ### It adds alternate wooden mosaic recipes that do not collide with the crafting table
#### IMPORTANT!!! This datapack is required only for adding those recipies to the existing worlds. As it is included in the mod from version 0.8.0 onwards, and should display in the datapack selection screen when creating a new world.
